products.title: Selank Nasal Spray
products.subtitle: 10 ml peptide spray · for laboratory research
products.description: VETUD Selank is presented in a 10 ml nasal spray bottle with its matching box. Selank is a synthetic peptide, a short chain of amino acids, studied for stress-related signaling and communication between nerve cells. This describes the peptide's research context, rather than a proven benefit of this VETUD product. The 10 ml label describes the amount of liquid in the bottle, not the amount of peptide. Ingredient information: Selank peptide (named on the label). The liquid carrier, preservatives and any other ingredients await manufacturer confirmation. The peptide concentration and total peptide content are not yet confirmed. Supplied for laboratory research only; not for human or veterinary use.
